title: Should Students Use Phones in Class?
text:
Many students carry smartphones to school every day. Some teachers think phones distract students and should be banned. Others believe phones can help students learn, because they offer quick access to dictionaries and information. This debate is becoming more important each year.

The writer thinks schools should allow phones with clear rules. For example, students can use them for research, but they must turn them off during tests. In this way, students learn to use technology responsibly. Therefore, the writer argues that banning phones completely is not the best solution.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, why do some people believe phones can help students?
options: They give quick access to dictionaries and information

questions.text: According to paragraph two, when must students turn off their phones?
What is the writer's main opinion about phones in schools?
options: Phones should be allowed with clear rules
Phones have no effect on learning
Teachers should hold all the phones

questions.text: Why does the writer think using phones with rules helps students?
options: Because students must manage their own behaviour
Because the teacher controls every action

paragraph_translations: Muchos estudiantes llevan teléfonos inteligentes a la escuela todos los días. Algunos profesores piensan que los teléfonos distraen a los estudiantes y deberían prohibirse. Otros creen que los teléfonos pueden ayudar a aprender, porque ofrecen acceso rápido a diccionarios e información. Este debate es cada vez más importante.

El autor piensa que las escuelas deberían permitir los teléfonos con reglas claras. Por ejemplo, los estudiantes pueden usarlos para investigar, pero deben apagarlos durante los exámenes. De esta manera, los estudiantes aprenden a usar la tecnología de manera responsable. Por lo tanto, el autor sostiene que prohibir los teléfonos por completo no es la mejor solución.
